The order is passed u/s. 45A of the ESI Act, 1948 for the period from June 2017 to July 2018 whereby the penalty has been re-assessed as Rs. 1,35,638/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty Five Thousand Six Hundred and Thirty Eight Only). Since the Company has already deposited 25% advance of Rs. 86,750/, the balance amount due and payable is Rs. 48,888/ - (Rupees Forty Eight Thousand Eight Hundred and Eighty Eight Only).

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,450.4 Cr (+6.7% YoY), net profit ₹210.6 Cr (+19.4% YoY).
On April 24, 2026, Zensar Technologies announced the board approval for appointing Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term starting from the 64th AGM.
Zensar Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,450.4 Cr and PAT of ₹210.6 Cr, alongside an order book of $401.8M.
Zensar Technologies released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting $643.7M revenue, 16.0% EBITDA margin, and $319.5M net cash.
Zensar Technologies received an ESG rating of 76 ('Leader') from NSE Sustainability Ratings for FY2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,585.2 Cr (+11.5% YoY), net profit ₹190.2 Cr (+4.4% YoY).
Zensar Technologies announced board approval for the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary M3bi India Private Limited on October 28, 2026.
Zensar Technologies reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,585.2 Cr and PAT of ₹190.2 Cr.
Audio recording of Q2FY27 earnings call held on 29 Oct 2026 made available on company website.
